info.name: MoreInfo
info.author: zhuyaqi
info.description: 在快捷栏旁显示盔甲与副手、精确耐久、FPS 和电池温度；提供随盒色潜影盒预览、鼠标悬停预览、副手双击交互、中英文设置及可选 Debug 日志。 Displays armor, offhand items, precise durability, FPS, and battery temperature beside the hotbar, with color-matched shulker previews, mouse-hover previews, double-tap offhand interaction, Chinese/English settings, and optional Debug logs.
